cells.gaps: No source found says a list of countries, model contract terms or a general authorisation has been published. COD-001 names authorisation or refusal as the authority's role in transfers; COD-005 adds the route to a destination with equivalent protection.
cells.note: Levellers says the Digital Code lets personal data go to a destination with equivalent protection without the minister's authorisation [COD-005], so question 2 is yes and the stage is 3. No published route answers question 3, so stage 4 is not met.
